nuit._heuresParJourNote: Heure de nuit propre à un jour de la semaine (0 dimanche … 6 samedi), sinon `heure`. Vendredi et samedi à 22 h : exposants ouverts jusqu’à 22 h ces soirs-là (Alexis, 18/10).

poi.desc:
*Côtes-d’Armor (22)*

- Protected heathland and grassland off limits, fences raised
- GR34 closed to the west, from the Grève de la Fosse
- Access by shuttle from the park-and-ride car parks; bike parking at La Teignouse; motorhomes not accepted at the Fréhel campsite

**Where to go instead:** The start live on the giant screens in the village, in Saint-Malo.

poi.arrete: RDR1, RDR2, P6, P5, P4, P3, P2, P1
poi.desc:
On Sunday 1 November from 11 am to 5 pm, reserved for competitors, the organisers and passenger vessels registered with OC Sport. Its exact perimeter is set by order 48 hours before the start.

Points RDR1, RDR2, P6, P5, P4, P3, P2 and P1 of annex I of order no. 2026/160 of the Atlantic maritime prefect, which alone is authoritative.

poi.arrete: P1 à P6, RDR3, RDR4, trait de côte, RDR5, RDR6
poi.desc:
On Sunday 1 November from 11 am to 5 pm: registered pleasure boats and traditional sailing ships under engine only, and commercial boats carrying 12 passengers at most. Fishing, anchoring, swimming, diving, sailing, personal watercraft and towed activities are prohibited.

Points P1 to P6, RDR3, RDR4, the coastline, RDR5 and RDR6 of annex I of order no. 2026/160 of the Atlantic maritime prefect, which alone is authoritative.

A north-south line at 1°54′ W, offshore between Saint-Malo and Pointe du Grouin, from the northern sighting boat (48°46.7′ N) to the southern sighting boat (48°43.5′ N): just under 6 km. Each class has its own section, from north to south: the Ultims and Ocean Fifties, the Vintage boats, the IMOCAs, then the Class40s.

Approximate coordinates from amendment 5 to the sailing instructions.

poi.descFr: Circulation et stationnement interdits le dimanche 1er novembre de 8 h à 16 h, sauf secours, forces de l’ordre, véhicules autorisés et mobilités douces (à pied, à vélo). Stationnement interdit dès le samedi 31 octobre à 20 h. Pour la pointe du Grouin, la RD 201 le long du littoral est à sens unique de Cancale vers Saint-Malo.
poi.descEn: No traffic or parking on Sunday 1 November from 8 am to 4 pm, except emergency services, police, authorised vehicles and soft mobility (on foot, by bike). No parking from Saturday 31 October at 8 pm. For Pointe du Grouin, the coastal RD 201 is one-way from Cancale towards Saint-Malo.

poi.nom: RD 34 coastal road to Cap Fréhel
poi.nomEn: RD 34 coastal road to Cap Fréhel
poi.descFr: Fermée à la circulation le dimanche 1er novembre de 7 h à 19 h, sauf navettes, secours, piétons et vélos. Stationnement interdit sur la route depuis le vendredi 30 octobre à 12 h. Pour le cap Fréhel, se garer aux parkings de Fréhel (camping municipal) ou de Plévenon, puis prendre les navettes gratuites de Dinan Agglomération.
poi.descEn: Closed to traffic on Sunday 1 November from 7 am to 7 pm, except shuttles, emergency services, pedestrians and cyclists. No parking along the road from Friday 30 October at noon.
